why: A hard link IS the file under a second name. It has no target to resolve to, so BOTH the lexical and the realpath form return the innocent name. Only fstat(st_nlink) on an open descriptor can see it.
incident: AURA, 2026-07-27 in aukora-one (closed). Re-measured OPEN in aukora-seed 2026-07-28: 'ln law/protected.txt notes/innocent.txt' then writing the innocent name overwrote the protected inode. aukora-seed#1.
